models.alias: 可灵 2.6 动作控制, Kling 2.6 Motion Control
models.description: Apply an uploaded or saved motion to a subject image with precise action and expression control. To use motion control, refer to the tool motion_control. If no motion‑related tools appear in tool/lists, reconnect to the MCP server to refresh most updated tools by instruct the user to restart the current host and start a new session.

arguments.name: prompt
arguments.description: Prompt describing the desired scene, motion, or expression. Required; empty string is allowed for no text guidance.

arguments.name: motionId
arguments.description: Positive decimal motion ID returned by motion_library_list. Provide either motionId or a video input, but not both.

arguments.name: motionDirection
arguments.description: Direction reference. image_direction follows the subject image and only supports motions from 3 to 10 seconds; motion_direction follows the motion video.

arguments.name: resolution
arguments.description: Output quality. 720p maps to std; 1080p maps to pro.

arguments.name: keepOriginalSound
arguments.description: Whether to retain the original sound from the motion video.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: Subject image URL containing a clear person or animal.

inputs.name: video
inputs.description: Motion-source video URL. Provide either this input or motionId, but not both.

models.alias: 可灵 3.0 动作控制, Kling 3.0 Motion Control

arguments.name: resolution

arguments.name: keepOriginalSound
arguments.description: Whether to retain the original sound from the motion video.

arguments.name: elements
arguments.description: Optional reusable subjects (Elements). JSON array string of {id, bindName}, e.g. [{"id":"12345","bindName":"Alice"}]. 'id' from element_create/element_list. Write <<<id>>> in the prompt where each subject should appear (an id may be referenced multiple times).

inputs.name: image

models.description: mix text, images, one reference video and image Element ids. Without video_1: up to 7 images, images+elements ≤7. With video_1: count provided image_* (any slots), images+elements ≤4. 1 video max. Image Elements ≤7; no video type Elements.

arguments.name: prompt
arguments.description: Text prompt. Reference an input image as 图片X (图片1=image_1, ...), the reference video as 视频1 (video_1). To reference a reusable image subject (Element), write <<<id>>> in the prompt and list that id in the 'elements' argument (an id may be referenced multiple times). Video subjects are not supported.

arguments.name: elements
arguments.description: Optional reusable image subjects (Elements). JSON array string of {id, bindName, type}, e.g. [{"id":"12345","bindName":"Alice","type":"image"}]. 'id' and 'type' from element_get; type must be image (video subjects are not supported). At most 7 image subjects. Write <<<id>>> in the prompt where each subject should appear (an id may be referenced multiple times). Without video_1, images+elements ≤7; with video_1, images+elements ≤4 (counted by how many image_* are provided, any slots).

arguments.name: duration
arguments.description: Output video duration in seconds (3 to 10). With a base/edit reference video, output duration may follow the input video (enforced downstream).

arguments.name: aspect_ratio
arguments.description: Output video aspect ratio.

arguments.name: resolution
arguments.description: Quality tier (member: up to 1080p).

arguments.name: imageCount
arguments.description: Number of videos to generate per request, max to 4.

models.description: mix text, images, one reference video and image/video Element ids. Without video_1: up to 7 images, images+elements ≤7, video subjects ≤3. With video_1: count provided image_* (any slots), images+elements ≤4; video subjects allowed only when there are no images or image subjects, at most 1. 1 video max. Image+video Elements ≤7. Audio-video sync and multi-shot supported.

arguments.name: prompt
arguments.description: Text prompt. Reference an input image as 图片X (图片1=image_1, ...), the reference video as 视频1 (video_1). To reference a reusable subject (Element), write <<<id>>> in the prompt and list that id in the 'elements' argument (an id may be referenced multiple times).

arguments.name: elements
arguments.description: Optional reusable subjects (Elements). JSON array string of {id, bindName, type}, e.g. [{"id":"12345","bindName":"Alice","type":"image"}]. 'id' and 'type' from element_get (type is image or video). At most 7 image+video subjects combined; at most 3 may be video. Without video_1, images+elements ≤7. With video_1, images+elements ≤4 (count of provided image_* plus elements, any slots); video subjects are allowed only when there are no images or image subjects, at most 1. Write <<<id>>> in the prompt where each subject should appear (an id may be referenced multiple times).

arguments.name: duration
arguments.description: Output video duration in seconds (3 to 15). With video_1, the official panel typically limits duration to 3–10 (11–15 may be grey-gated downstream). With a base/edit reference video, output duration may follow the input video (enforced downstream).

arguments.name: aspect_ratio
arguments.description: Output video aspect ratio. Use auto when at least one image_* is provided (follow the input), or for a video-edit task whose video_1 is the base video. When video_1 is a reference video, pass a specific ratio: 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1. For text-only, pass 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1.

arguments.name: resolution
arguments.description: Quality tier. 720p=std, 1080p=pro. 4k for members.

arguments.name: imageCount
arguments.description: Number of videos to generate per request. max to 4

arguments.name: prefer_multi_shots
arguments.description: Whether to enable smart multi-shot splitting (intelligent shot composition). Downstream may force false for base-video edit and true for reference-video.

arguments.name: enable_audio
arguments.description: Generate new synced audio (音画同步). Only one of enable_audio and keepOriginalSound may be true. For new audio use enable_audio=true and keepOriginalSound=false. When video_1 is provided, enable_audio must be false.

arguments.name: keepOriginalSound
arguments.description: Keep the original sound of the reference video. Only one of enable_audio and keepOriginalSound may be true. To keep the source sound use keepOriginalSound=true and enable_audio=false.
